name: Gakkou no Seiiki
source:
This is the third game in feng's Seiiki series, this time with two heroines instead of just one. Youhei's older sister Yaeka Nase is his homeroom teacher. She looks dignified as a teacher, and is very popular amongst the students. However, she's always drunk at home and leads a very loose private life.

His classmate Maika Ootori is a transfer student who is into all things Akiba. She always invites him after school to go walk around Akiba. He's gotten used to seeing her with a grilled squid in one hand and buying up doujinshi and doujin games.

This daily life, which he thought would continue forever, changed completely when rumours spread that Maika would be suddenly called back to her home country. Youhei and Yaeka try their best to help her remain in Japan.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/11/21/november-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是feng的《Seiiki》系列第三部，这次的女主角从一人增加到了两人。那濑弥生是洋平的姐姐，也是他的班主任。作为教师，她看起来威严端庄，在学生中非常受欢迎。然而，她在家里总是醉醺醺的，私生活十分放纵。

他的同班同学大鸟舞香是一名热衷秋叶原一切事物的转校生。她总是邀请洋平放学后去秋叶原逛逛。他已经习惯看到她一手拿着烤鱿鱼，一手买下一堆同人志和同人游戏。

他以为这种日常会永远持续下去，然而，当舞香即将被突然召回祖国的传闻传开后，一切都彻底改变了。洋平和弥生竭尽全力，想帮助她留在日本。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/11/21/november-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
